findings.title: Sponsored Soroban transactions copy the simulation's resource fee into the envelope with no cap, so the distribution account pays whatever the RPC returns
Env distribution signer signs envelopes without inspecting their operations
Channel-account signer signs any envelope it is given without inspecting its operations
DB-vault distribution signer adds the distribution signature to any envelope it is given, without inspecting operations or fee account
Sponsored transactions sign caller-supplied Soroban invocations with the distribution key, with no check of contract, function or arguments
DB-vault fee-bump signer pays fees for any fee-bump envelope without checking fee account, fee cap or inner transaction
Sponsored Soroban resource fee is not bounded before the distribution account pays it
Sponsored operation validation decodes the XDR but never binds the invocation to the stored SponsoredAccount contract, function or arguments
Wallet creation attaches simulation resource data with no cap, so the distribution account pays whatever the RPC returns
Reconciliation clears the submitted hash on NotFound, so a payment that landed after a Horizon timeout is paid again with a fresh sequence
SEP-29 memo-required check disabled on every payment submission
No cumulative spend budget on distribution-funded payments
Build-time validation errors are never marked ERROR, so a permanently invalid payment loops forever and holds a channel account

No per-payment amount cap before signing with the distribution key
